import sys

def get_status(x, y, direction):
    result = 0
    result = x
    result = (result << 9) | y
    result = (result << 3) | direction
    return result

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    k = int(data[0])
    MAX = 311
    mask = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]

    dx = [1, 1, 0, -1, -1, -1, 0, 1]
    dy = [0, -1, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 1]

    cur_queue = set()
    cur_queue.add(get_status(MAX // 2, MAX // 2, 0))

    index = 1
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        next_value = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        new_queue = set()
        for cur in cur_queue:
            cur_direction = cur & 0x7
            cur_y = (cur >> 3) & 0x1FF
            cur_x = (cur >> 12) & 0x1FF

            j = 1
            while True:
                cur_x += dx[cur_direction]
                cur_y += dy[cur_direction]
                mask[cur_x][cur_y] = 1
                if j == next_value:
                    new_queue.add(get_status(cur_x, cur_y, (cur_direction + 1) % 8))
                    new_dir = (cur_direction - 1) % 8
                    if new_dir < 0:
                        new_dir = 8 + new_dir
                    new_queue.add(get_status(cur_x, cur_y, new_dir % 8))
                    break
                j += 1
        cur_queue = new_queue

    res = 0
    for i in range(MAX):
        for j in range(MAX):
            if mask[i][j] == 1:
                res += 1

    sys.stdout.write(str(res) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys

def get_status(x, y, direction):
    result = 0
    result = x
    result = (result << 9) | y
    result = (result << 3) | direction
    return result

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    k = int(data[0])
    MAX = 311
    mask = [[0] * MAX for _ in range(MAX)]

    dx = [1, 1, 0, -1, -1, -1, 0, 1]
    dy = [0, -1, -1, -1, 0, 1, 1, 1]

    cur_queue = set()
    cur_queue.add(get_status(MAX // 2, MAX // 2, 0))

    index = 1
    for i in range(1, k + 1):
        next_value = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        new_queue = set()
        for cur in cur_queue:
            cur_direction = cur & 0x7
            cur_y = (cur >> 3) & 0x1FF
            cur_x = (cur >> 12) & 0x1FF

            j = 1
            while True:
                cur_x += dx[cur_direction]
                cur_y += dy[cur_direction]
                mask[cur_x][cur_y] = 1
                if j == next_value:
                    new_queue.add(get_status(cur_x, cur_y, (cur_direction + 1) % 8))
                    new_queue.add(get_status(cur_x, cur_y, (cur_direction - 1) % 8))
                    break
                j += 1
        cur_queue = new_queue

    res = 0
    for i in range(MAX):
        for j in range(MAX):
            if mask[i][j] == 1:
                res += 1

    sys.stdout.write(str(res) + '\n')

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
